claim_contract.objects: rational A, theta, nu and rational-coefficient barrier polynomial f
claim_contract.extension_assumptions: f(A)=sum_i w_i*A^(r_i); w_i positive rational; sum_i w_i=1; integer r_i>=2
claim_contract.conclusion: rational feasibility iff nu > s/(s-1), s=sum_i w_i*r_i
claim_contract.scope: local auxiliary-parameter feasibility ONLY, not a theorem about pi

mechanism.key_object: gap ratio (A-theta)/(1-theta); endpoint slope plus a GLOBAL tangent certificate
mechanism.necessity: theta>f(A) and global tangent inequality imply (A-theta)/(1-theta)<(s-1)/s
mechanism.sufficiency: rational A approaches 1 from below, then choose theta in (f(A), min(A,(nu*A-1)/(nu-1)))
mechanism.general_fixed_A: With b=max(0,f(A)), 0<A<1 and b<A, rational theta feasible iff nu>(1-b)/(A-b).
mechanism.general_global: nu>inf_A (1-b(A))/(A-b(A)) over rational admissible A; +infinity if none

proof_obligations.statement: positive coefficient polynomial identity for all rational A in (0,1)
strict inequality at threshold excludes nu=s/(s-1)
construct rational witness for every rational nu above threshold
the high-level source interpolation theorem is correct

boundaries.consequence: endpoint derivative alone does not imply sharp threshold

reusable_results: Polynomial mixtures have critical nu=s/(s-1) with s=f'(1).
Arbitrary rational-valued barriers have fixed-A cutoff (1-max(0,f(A)))/(A-max(0,f(A))).
A single rational positive witness refutes derivative-only extrapolation without global curvature assumptions.
